ndx_error: NDX levels were not computed this run (HTTPError).
notes: Call wall / put wall = strike above / below spot with the largest call / put dollar gamma, across every expiration; *_2 is the runner-up strike, often nearly tied (compare the *_gex_bn values). Gamma flip = SteelyGamma's estimate of the spot where net dealer gamma (long calls, short puts) crosses zero; other providers' flips differ. Open interest is from the prior session (oi_new = false means it had not yet updated at run time). stage premarket (about 08:30 ET) is replaced by stage open (about 09:50 ET), anchored at 09:35. nq.* are the NDX and QQQ levels mapped to the anchor's NQ contract; es.* are the SPX and SPY levels mapped to the anchor's ES contract (es_error instead when they could not be computed). Not trading advice. latest-v2.json: NQ levels from QQQ and, when NDX options are available, NDX (ndx_error instead when not); latest.json keeps the original shape and is updated only when NDX is available.
